## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Perugia, Italy. It starts at Via Cardinale Raffaele Merry del Val, 3, 06081 Assisi, PG, Italy.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Experience 800 years of history in the famous woods where the patron saint of Italy meditated and prayed.
>
> As you climb to the top of the 14th-century tower, the Bosco di San Francesco unfolds. Feast your eyes on Michelangelo Pistoletto's "Third Paradise" – a masterpiece of 121 olive trees, arranged in double rows to form three large concentric circles – that symbolises the union between heaven and earth.
>
> Back on the ground, take the artist's invitation and walk the winding road among the rows, becoming part of the work as you go. It's a real call for reflection on the possible peaceful coexistence between man and nature.
